71898-sexual-ethics.title: Sexual Ethics
71898-sexual-ethics.creator: Unknown
71898-sexual-ethics.description: A public-domain book from Project Gutenberg. The great philosopher Kant founded upon the instinct of conscience his Categorical Imperative, and held the further investigation of its causes to be unnecessary. If the conscience says “Thou shalt,” one must simply act accordingly. This is, in Kant’s opinion, the absolute moral law, which bids or forbids an action independently of any other consideration.

arxiv-2303-13920.title: Sharp metastability transition for two-dimensional bootstrap percolation with symmetric isotropic threshold rules
arxiv-2303-13920.creator: Hugo Duminil-Copin, Ivailo Hartarsky
arxiv-2303-13920.description: Abstract We study two-dimensional critical bootstrap percolation models. We establish that a class of these models including all isotropic threshold rules with a convex symmetric neighbourhood, undergoes a sharp metastability transition. This extends previous instances proved for several specific rules. The paper supersedes a draft by Alexander Holroyd and the first author from 2012.

arxiv-2307-01387.title: ALBERTI, a Multilingual Domain Specific Language Model for Poetry Analysis
arxiv-2307-01387.creator: Javier de la Rosa, Alvaro Perez Pozo, Salvador Ros, Elena Gonzalez-Blanco
arxiv-2307-01387.description: Abstract The computational analysis of poetry is limited by the scarcity of tools to automatically analyze and scan poems. In a multilingual settings, the problem is exacerbated as scansion and rhyme systems only exist for individual languages, making comparative studies very challenging and time consuming.

arxiv-2308-11330.title: Dynamical Representation of Frames in Tensor Product of Hardy Spaces
arxiv-2308-11330.description: Abstract Dynamical Sampling of frames and tensor products are important topics in harmonic analysis. This paper combines the concepts of dynamical sampling of frames and the Carleson condition in the tensor product of Hardy spaces. Initially we discuss the preservation of the frame property under the tensor product on the Hilbert spaces.

arxiv-2311-08789.title: Unraveling Proton Strangeness: Determination of the Strangeness Sigma Term with Statistical Significance
arxiv-2311-08789.creator: Wei Kou, Xurong Chen
arxiv-2311-08789.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Wei Kou, Xurong Chen. This study delves into the contribution of the strange quark within the proton, which influences several fundamental proton properties. By establishing a robust relationship between the proton’s quantum anomalous energy and the sigma term, we successfully extract the contribution of the strangeness sigma term in the proton, obtaining it from parameterized fits of the differential cross-section using exponential and dipole forms.

arxiv-2312-00038.title: A Physics-Constrained Neural Ordinary Differential Equations Approach for Robust Learning of Stiff Chemical Kinetics
arxiv-2312-00038.creator: Tadbhagya Kumar, Anuj Kumar, Pinaki Pal, [10pt] Transportation and Power Systems Division, Argonne National Laboratory, Lemont, IL, [-5pt] Department of Mechanical Engineering, North Carolina State University, Raleigh, NC [-5pt]
arxiv-2312-00038.description: Abstract The high computational cost associated with solving for detailed chemistry poses a significant challenge for predictive computational fluid dynamics (CFD) simulations of turbulent reacting flows. These models often require solving a system of coupled stiff ordinary differential equations (ODEs), which becomes the computational bottleneck.

arxiv-2502-18575.title: Colored Jones Polynomials and the Volume Conjecture
arxiv-2502-18575.creator: Mark Hughes, ​​, Vishnu Jejjala, ​​, P. Ramadevi, ​​, Pratik Roy, ​​, Vivek Kumar Singh
arxiv-2502-18575.description: Abstract Using the vertex model approach for braid representations, we compute polynomials for spin- 1 1 placed on hyperbolic knots up to 15 15 crossings. These polynomials are referred to as 3 3 -colored Jones polynomials or adjoint Jones polynomials.

arxiv-2504-16445.title: Power-based control of output oscillations with online estimation of biased harmonics Authors accepted manuscript
arxiv-2504-16445.creator: Michael Ruderman, Denis Efimov
arxiv-2504-16445.description: Abstract The recently introduced discrete power-based control ( Ruderman 2024b ) reduces largely the communication efforts in the control loop when compensating for the marginally damped or even slowly diverging output oscillations. The control commutates twice per oscillations period (at the amplitude peaks) and uses the measured harmonic output only.

arxiv-2507-14732.title: Spiral renormalization group flow and universal entanglement spectrum of the non-Hermitian 5-state Potts model
arxiv-2507-14732.creator: Vic Vander Linden, Boris De Vos, Kevin Vervoort, Frank Verstraete, Atsushi Ueda
arxiv-2507-14732.description: Abstract The quantum 5 5 -state Potts model is known to possess a perturbative description using complex conformal field theory (CCFT), the analytic continuation of “theory space” to a complex plane. To study the corresponding complex fixed point on the lattice, the model must be deformed by an additional non-Hermitian term due to its complex coefficient λ \lambda .

arxiv-2511-10430.title: Fuzzy Black Holes from Mass Generation in Matrix Compactification
arxiv-2511-10430.creator: Davide Laurenzano, and John F. Wheater
arxiv-2511-10430.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Davide Laurenzano, and John F. Wheater. We investigate a mechanism for generating mass terms in the IKKT and BFSS matrix theories through compactification on a torus and the derivation of a zero-mode effective theory, emphasizing the crucial role of fermionic boundary conditions. Extending a recent proposal developed for the IKKT model to the BFSS framework, we explore a broader class of mixed fermionic boundary conditions in both theories.

arxiv-2511-12982.title: SafeGRPO: Self-Rewarded Multimodal Safety Alignment via Rule-Governed Policy Optimization
arxiv-2511-12982.creator: Xuankun Rong, Wenke Huang, Tingfeng Wang, Daiguo Zhou, Bo Du, Mang Ye
arxiv-2511-12982.description: Abstract Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) have demonstrated impressive reasoning and instruction-following capabilities, yet their expanded modality space introduces new compositional safety risks that emerge from complex text–image interactions. Such cross-modal couplings can produce unsafe semantics even when individual inputs are benign, exposing the fragile safety awareness of current MLLMs.

arxiv-2512-03367.title: Pairs of eventually constant maps and nilpotent pairs
arxiv-2512-03367.creator: Weixi Chen, Mee Seong Im, Mikhail Khovanov, Catherine Lillja, Nicolas Rugo
arxiv-2512-03367.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Weixi Chen, Mee Seong Im, Mikhail Khovanov, Catherine Lillja, Nicolas Rugo. Tom Leinster gave a bijective correspondence between the set of operators on a finite-dimensional vector space V V and the set of pairs consisting of a nilpotent operator and a vector in V V . Over a finite field this bijection implies that the probability that an operator be nilpotent is the reciprocal of the number of vectors in V V .

pmc-10712948.title: Assessing drug safety by identifying the axis of arrhythmia in cardiomyocyte electrophysiology
pmc-10712948.creator: Stewart Heitmann, Jamie I Vandenberg, Adam P Hill, Christopher L-H Huang, Stewart Heitmann, Jamie I Vandenberg, Adam P Hill
pmc-10712948.description: Many classes of drugs can induce fatal cardiac arrhythmias by disrupting the electrophysiology of cardiomyocytes. Safety guidelines thus require all new drugs to be assessed for pro-arrhythmic risk prior to conducting human trials. The standard safety protocols primarily focus on drug blockade of the delayed-rectifier potassium current (IKr).

pmc-11685050.title: Association between erectile dysfunction and the predicted 10-year risk for atherosclerosis cardiovascular disease among U.S. men: a population-based study from the NHANES 2001-2004
pmc-11685050.creator: Yangyang Mei, Yiming Chen, Xiaogang Wang, Renfang Xu, Rui Xu, Xingliang Feng
pmc-11685050.description: BackgroundErectile dysfunction (ED) is considered the tip of the iceberg for cardiovascular disease (CVD). However, there is still conflicting evidence regarding their relationship. Recently, a validated tool for the Atherosclerotic Cardiovascular Disease (ASCVD) risk score has provided a key opportunity to delve deeper into the relationship between ED and CVD.

pmc-12487251.title: Hypertension in West Africa: a systematic review and meta-analysis of prevalence and associated risk factors
pmc-12487251.creator: Monday Nwankwo, Wusa Makena, Aisha Idris, Chikezie Jude Okamkpa, Anyanwu G Emeka, Elna Owembabazi, Elizabeth Bessy Umoren
pmc-12487251.description: BackgroundHypertension remains a critical modifiable risk factor contributing to the global burden of cardiovascular disease. Despite its escalating prevalence in West Africa, comprehensive regional data on its epidemiological patterns and associated determinants remain sparse. This study addresses this gap through a systematic review and meta-analysis, synthesizing existing evidence on hypertension prevalence and its risk factors across West African populations.

pmc-12537400.creator: Shi-Kai Cao, Nenghui Ye, Zhenning Teng, Birendra Prasad Shaw, Rui Liu, Jianhua Zhang

This Research Topic brings together five innovative studies that employ advanced genetic, molecular, and physiological strategies to optimize crop productivity and stress adaptation.

uslaw-usc-t44-s707.description: United States Code, Title 44 (Public Printing And Documents); Chapter 7 (Congressional Printing And Binding). Current through Public Law 119-134, as published by the Office of the Law Revision Counsel. Subject to sections 205 and 206 of Title 1, the Joint Committee on Printing may authorize the printing of a bill or resolution, with index and ancillaries, in the style and form the Joint Committee on Printing considers most suitable in the.
